audit.whatIsWrong: The page is labelled FAV with a red tone and an 8.5/10 difficulty, and its headline says 'He kites you out — survive' — while its own mid and late text say Fiora wins every clean 1v1.
audit.why: 54.17% over 264 games is a favoured lane. An 8.5/10 difficulty and a hard-matchup rating line contradict both the data and the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 4/10, tone to the favoured green used on Fiora's other FAV pages, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] restated, and the TL;DR rewritten to the advice the page actually gives.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every level row except two was handed to Ziggs, with 2/10 ratings, on a lane Fiora wins 54%.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Fiora for rows 1-6 and Skill at 2+ items, and the whys read the same way: whys[1]-[4] describe Fiora out-sustaining and running him down, whys[6] gives the late range war back to a fully itemised Ziggs.
audit.corrected: win[0..5] to Fiora, win[6] to Skill, with the full phases sides and ratings flipped as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, though the entire page is built on 'engage while his Q is down' and 'engage when Satchel is down'.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s — a very short window that shrinks as he ranks it, which is exactly why walking up on its cooldown needs a number. Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s and knocks both of you away, Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s slow zone, Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s.
audit.corrected: Real numbers in breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects reports 4 probable wrong ability names.
audit.why: All four are false positives — 'Bouncing Bombs', 'Satchel Charges', 'Save Satchel Charge' and 'His Bouncing Bomb' are the correct names carrying a plural, a verb form or a possessive.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — his knockback self-peel; engage while it is down. - Bouncing Bomb: 6s at rank 1, 4s maxed — his only lane damage. - Hexplosive Minefield: a flat 16s slow zone. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: This page was internally inconsistent before the audit: diff FAV with a red tone and 8.5/10 difficulty, a 'he kites you out' TL;DR, and a level chart giving Ziggs five of seven rows — all on a 54.17% lane whose own mid/late text says Fiora wins every clean 1v1. I corrected the ratings and the chart to match the win rate and the prose. Satchel Charge knocks Ziggs himself away as well, which the page's 'parry the displacement to stay on top of him' framing already handles correctly.
